ops.body:
Lane snapshot-oversize-clip handoff (Nov 6, 11:55 AM PT). Brief: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/snapshot-oversize-clip.md. Finding note: ccn 857ade72 (captain-hook repo).

Decision: meta-desk-3 (team-lead) picked option A at 11:48 AM: clip in cc-transcript's encoder (tool output first, byte-count marker; tool name, input, command and paths whole). B (remember the oversized event) is out. Ship order: cc-transcript PR, admin merge on green, release through the repo's normal path (tag v* triggers release-pypi.yml; last tag v14.46.17); then a captain-hook PR bumping the cc-transcript pin (pyproject.toml "cc-transcript[judge]==14.46.16" plus uv.lock) with the 2 MB test, admin merge on green. One landed record per PR (--pr, --to meta-desk,install-desk), then SendMessage team-lead both PRs, merge shas and the release tag. Installs are install-desk's. Never post --kind done.

State:
- cc-transcript worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-transcript/snapshot-oversize-clip (from origin/main 75d04f2). Added encode_clipped, Clippable, clipped, clippable_fields, clip, json_len to rust/crates/core/src/snapshot_codec.rs after encode. Clips string fields under ToolResult/result content and tool_use_result first, then Text/Thinking/Plain/prompt, largest first, marker "<clipped from N bytes>"; skips ToolUse, call, ref, edits, meta subtrees; refuses with the original reason when still over. Applies only when max_bytes >= MAX_RECORD_BYTES.
- Still to do in cc-transcript: switch snapshot_codec::encode to encode_clipped at snapshot_projection.rs turns (~2072), events (~2189), tool_calls (~2391) and snapshot.rs tail_data (~8650, ~8672); add Rust tests in snapshot_codec tests (2 MiB tool output event and tool use kept under bound with marker twice and decodable; protected 2 MiB tool_use input still refused); cargo check/clippy -p cc-transcript-core; ship PR.
- captain-hook worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/captain-hook/snapshot-oversize-clip (from origin/main f60aed8): untouched. Test plan: tests use captain_hook/testing/snapshots.py FixtureOwner (real cc-transcript-owner from the venv). Add a test in tests/test_conditions.py beside test_session_scope_reads_prompts_past_a_turn_over_the_record_bound: 2 MB Bash output event is kept in .events, clipped under 1 MiB with the marker, RanCommand("cat") still matches. tests/test_snapshot_review_consumers.py:799 asserts the review path skips an oversized event; the review path (owner review_events.rs) is not changed, so it should keep passing.
